name: When do I need to call a professional for toilet overflow with sewage?

mainEntity.name: When do I need to call a professional for toilet overflow with sewage?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should call a professional restoration company immediately if your toilet overflows with sewage. This type of incident is classified as a Category 3 'black water' contamination, which requires specialized handling, cleanup, and disinfection to prevent health hazards and extensive property damage. Early intervention can minimize the spread of contamination and reduce overall restoration costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Call a professional restoration company immediately for any toilet overflow with sewage, as it's a Category 3 contamination requiring specialized handling.
